name: MixAI Music for Mac
subtitle: Your own music server
promotionalText: Your own music library from your MixAI server, in a Mac window: gapless albums, automix, synced lyrics, media keys, menu bar mini player. No ads, no tracking.
description:
MixAI Music for Mac plays YOUR music: the albums on your own MixAI server at home, in a fast desktop window. No ads, no subscription, no catalogue we sell you.

LISTEN
• Albums play gapless; automix crossfades other tracks on the beat, with tempo matched.
• Start a mix: endless radio from your library, or from any song, album or artist.
• Synced lyrics, queue editing, shuffle, repeat and harmonic (key-aware) radio order.

MADE FOR THE MAC
• Media keys and the macOS Now Playing controls in Control Center.
• Menu bar menu and an always-on-top mini player.
• Global shortcuts: Control-Option-Space play/pause, Control-Option-arrows next/previous.
• Sign in with your browser; the window remembers its size and keeps playing when closed.
• mixai-music:// links open albums, artists or a queue straight in the app.

EVERY SCREEN
• Same library and profiles on iPhone, Apple TV, Android, Windows and the web.
• Hand the queue to your MixAI TV in one click.

MixAI Music needs a MixAI server (free, self-hosted) with your own music files.
